flights.label: Depart
flights.text: Sat Sept 26, 8:25 AM — Air Transat 151 to Montreal (arrives 5:45 PM). Seats 26H & 26J.

snapshot.label: Free days
snapshot.text: Sept 16 & 17 in Lima; free evening Sept 25.

snapshot.label: Tour meeting point
snapshot.text: Hotel El Señorial, {address}. Welcome meeting Day 1 (Sept 18) at 2:00 PM.
snapshot.address: Hotel El Señorial, Calle José Gonzáles 567, Miraflores, Lima

snapshot.label: Luggage
snapshot.text: Main bags stay at hotels in Cusco and Puno — pack a daypack for Aguas Calientes (Sept 20–21) and the Lake Titicaca homestay (Sept 24).

altitude.text: Sea level in Lima → Cusco 3,450 m (Sept 19) → Lake Titicaca 3,800 m (Sept 23–24). Go slow, hydrate, ask a doctor about altitude meds.

reservations.name: Lady Bee
reservations.address: Lady Bee, Av. Pedro de Osma 205, Barranco, Lima
reservations.note: Peru's top-ranked cocktail bar; small plates too.

reservations.name: Maido
reservations.address: Maido, Calle San Martín 399, Miraflores, Lima
reservations.note: Experience Maido — Mitsuharu Tsumura's 12-step Nikkei menu, with the Maridaje Tokujou pairing. S/ 2,525 pp.

reservations.name: Machu Picchu
reservations.address: Machu Picchu Historic Sanctuary, Cusco Region, Peru
reservations.note: Guided tour of the citadel; passport checked at the gate.

farewell.title: Have the best trip
farewell.text: Eleven days, four altitudes, one very cold night on a reed island. Michael & Laura, Sept 2026.
